d.ko: Survive 20 waves in this wuxia action roguelite. Master 153 martial arts, collect 247 items, and face 55 enemy types from 8 factions. Combine Outer, Inner, and Movement Arts, then snowball your build with Resonance, Stored Power, Combos, and training bonuses to become a martial arts master.
d.en: Survive 20 waves in this wuxia action roguelite. Master 153 martial arts, collect 247 items, and face 55 enemy types from 8 factions. Combine Outer, Inner, and Movement Arts, then snowball your build with Resonance, Stored Power, Combos, and training bonuses to become a martial arts master.
d.zh: 《群侠传：幸存者》是一款武侠题材的幸存者类动作肉鸽游戏。在 20 波江湖围攻中辗转腾挪，习得武学、搜罗奇物。153 门武学、247 件道具任你搭配，迎战来自 8 方势力的 55 种敌人。外功破阵、内功筑基、轻功游身，借武学共鸣、蓄势连携与修炼加成，将百家所长融于一身，从初入江湖到横扫群雄，成就一代宗师。
